convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'ElderImpulseSystem' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Also depends on external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution, position management, and money management functions.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA trades
TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite signal from ElderImpulseSystem triggers close of existing position - BUY_Close when indicator value is 1 (bearish impulse), SELL_Close when indicator value is 2 (bullish impulse)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode determines interpretation: LOT=fixed lots, FIELDS=risk percentage of margin, PERCENT=deposit fraction. Positive MM value used as fixed lots when MMMode=LOT; as percentage/fraction otherwise. Handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.

custom_logic_notes: The ElderImpulseSystem custom indicator returns color codes in buffer 4: 0=neutral, 1=bearish impulse (red bar - EMA declining AND MACD histogram falling), 2=bullish impulse (green bar - EMA rising AND MACD histogram rising). Long entry requires current signal bar=2 AND previous bar was NOT 2 (Value[0]==1 or Value[0]==0), meaning a fresh bullish impulse transition. Short entry requires current signal bar=1 AND previous bar was NOT 1 (Value[0]==0 or Value[0]==2), meaning a fresh bearish impulse transition. When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated on every tick. BuyPosClose/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosOpen booleans control which trade actions are enabled. LoadHistory() call ensures bar data availability. Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for position open reference time.
python_conversion_notes: The ElderImpulseSystem indicator must be replicated in Python: it combines a 13-period EMA slope direction with MACD histogram direction - bullish when both EMA is rising AND MACD histogram is rising, bearish when both are falling. Buffer 4 color codes: 0=neutral, 1=bearish, 2=bullish. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) must be reimplemented. The MMMode enum (LOT/FIELDS/PERCENT) controls position sizing interpretation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points, not pips - may need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (divide by 10 for 4-digit equivalents). The new bar guard via CIsNewBar class must be replicated. Signal is evaluated on bar [SignalBar] with confirmation from bar [SignalBar+1].
